name: nortest
resume: All five exports match nortest 1.0-4. The normal cdf is math.erf. The log cdf, the normal quantile, and the chi-square tail are SciPy. There is no crate.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(nortest))
x <- c(2.1, 3.4, NA, 1.2, 5.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.8, 6.1, 1.9, NaN, 4.4)
one <- function() ad.test(x)
invisible(one())
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf("%.17g\n", median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import statistics
import time

from nortest import ad_test

x = [2.1, 3.4, float("nan"), 1.2, 5.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.8, 6.1, 1.9, float("nan"), 4.4]


def one():
    return ad_test(x)


one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("%.17g" % statistics.median(elapsed))
